notes.general_comments: Most candidates used their time wisely and made a good attempt to answer the questions appropriately and to the best of their ability. They found the suggested length for Question 1 adequate to complete the task and there were comparatively few answers to the composition that were incomplete or ineffectively finished. There was evidence that to produce good responses, candidates thought carefully about their writing before they started the composition. Planning was essential for the argumentative/discursive writing, if only to check that they had enough to say and that they could develop each of their arguments at sufficient length. It was more difficult to plan the descriptive and narrative writing, but some thought as to the structure of each genre was also advisable. In the case of the narrative writing it was important to think of an interesting ending and to ensure that the important events of the plot, including the climax, were properly managed.
